### **Working directory set up**
 *The wizard will guide you through the process to set up working directories for the Gap analysis.*
 ***

Landrace Gap Analysis App is an R-shiny application developed in R software version 4.2.2. This app uses local resources for processing, it will save and load file locally as it needs. To start the process user must select a folder where all inputs, intermediate-inputs and outputs will be stored.

1. Write the Crop name in the Crop name field.
2. Click the button **"Browse"** for the root folder in which the App directory system will be created.
3. Finally, click on **"Select"**  button, this will create all necessary folder to store inputs, results, etc...
